properties.name: Carmona National High School
properties.source: Manila Bulletin, 11 Nov 2020: during Typhoon Ulysses, Carmona moved families from high-risk areas of Mabuhay and other barangays to public schools. Which schools was not reported.
properties.note: In the Poblacion, east of Mabuhay.

properties.name: Mabuhay Barangay Hall
properties.source: Barangay halls usually serve as the barangay's command post and first refuge in a disaster. Not confirmed for Mabuhay.

properties.name: Carmona Evacuation Center (DPWH)
properties.source: DPWH news release 19249 (2020): an evacuation centre DPWH built in Barangay Lantic, later enlarged by the city into a 3,000 m² multi-purpose building with a basketball court, and used as a quarantine facility in 2020.
properties.note: Not in OpenStreetMap, so its position is unknown. Ask Carmona CDRRMO where it is, then add lat and lon here.
